# Mario Martinez Jr. | Cybersecurity Portfolio

## About

Mario Martinez Jr. is a cybersecurity professional, AP Computer Science and Cybersecurity teacher, and TryHackMe USA Top 1% practitioner (Rank #76 globally as of 2026). He has been working in computer security since BBS networks in the 1980s. He documents TryHackMe walkthroughs, publishes cybersecurity articles grounded in practitioner experience, and offers flat-rate security and career services.

Site: https://ku5e.com
Contact: ku5e@ku5e.com
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/mario-martinez-jr-mba-8a831813
GitHub: https://github.com/ku5e
TryHackMe: https://tryhackme.com/p/ku5e

## Services

Security Audit (Starting at $499): Code review for web application vulnerabilities with a written findings report, severity ratings, and specific remediation steps. Three tiers: Entry Scan ($499, 72hr), Standard Audit ($1,200-$2,500), Full Certification.
https://ku5e.com/services/security-audit/

Resume + LinkedIn Review ($97): Line-by-line review against current cybersecurity and tech hiring standards. Specific rewrites, not a checklist. 48hr turnaround.
https://ku5e.com/services/resume-linkedin-review/

Cybersecurity Career Roadmap ($47): Structured 90-day plan built around your certifications, experience level, and target role. 48hr turnaround.
https://ku5e.com/services/cybersecurity-career-roadmap/

AP CS FRQ Feedback ($25-$45): Line-by-line feedback on AP Computer Science Free Response Questions for students and teachers.
https://ku5e.com/services/ap-cs-frq-feedback/
